turns.sql:
WITH gold_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        dp.client_id,
        dp.account_id,
        d.district_id
    FROM card c
    INNER JOIN disp dp ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    INNER JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
)
SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.client_id) AS total_gold_users,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount > d.A11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_users_with_large_loans,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.amount > d.A11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT gc.client_id), 0) AS percentage
FROM district d
INNER JOIN gold_clients gc ON d.district_id = gc.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON gc.account_id = l.account_id
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.client_id) > 0
ORDER BY percentage DESC;
